appshell_scope_to_profile: Scope admin views to a profile
dashboard_subtitle_admin: Here's an overview of your agent workspace.
dashboard_subtitle_user: Here's an overview of your usage and recent activity.
dashboard_quick_collections_desc: Choose the active collection and manage the knowledge base
dashboard_debug_recording: Recording every LLM / RAG / tool / decision step to debug_interactions
dashboard_verification_on: Fact-checks every answer against tool data before it streams
dashboard_verification_complex_on: Fact-checks complex answers before they stream
dashboard_verification_off: Off — answers stream without a verification pass
dashboard_verification_hint: Per-agent setting — reflects the profile selected in the top bar
dashboard_doc_vault_desc: Upload your documents so the agent can answer questions grounded in your own content.
account_settings_subtitle: Your profile, token usage, and recent activity.
account_security_subtitle: Your password, the devices you're signed in on and your connected Google account are managed in your PACOD account.
response_cache_intro: Serve a cached answer when a new question is semantically similar to a previously answered one — skipping the agent pipeline. Only first-turn questions (no prior chat history) are cached. Changes apply on the next chat turn — no restart.
response_cache_threshold_hint: Minimum semantic similarity to count as a match. Higher = safer / fewer hits. 90% is a starting point — validate against known-distinct questions.
response_cache_ttl_hint: Cached answers older than this are ignored and dropped, so stale answers age out.
response_cache_clear_hint: Flush all cached answers + reset counters — use after reference-fact, directive or model changes that would make cached answers stale.
debug_console_intro: One row per request — chat turns, reviews and newsletter runs — captured while debug mode was on, with the agent that triggered it. Open a request to inspect every LLM, RAG, tool and decision step with full payloads and timing.
debug_console_empty: No debug interactions. Enable debug mode on the dashboard, then run a chat turn.
debug_detail_rejected: Rejected by a guard before processing:
debug_detail_rejected_no_steps: Rejected before the agent ran — no interactions were recorded.
redis_intro: Server stats, user quota counters, topic classifier cache and conversation history.
redis_conversation_intro: Rolling per-session conversation summaries — older messages are folded into a summary and fed back to the planner and synthesizer so long chats keep context.
directives_intro: High-priority instructions injected at the top of the agent's answer prompt — interpreted before all other rules (but never override the refusal of illegal requests). Lower priority numbers are injected first.
directives_field_content_ph: The instruction the agent must follow with highest priority.
agent_prompts_intro: The system prompts the agent uses in each phase — topic classifier, planner, synthesizer, verifier, and follow-up suggestions. Edits apply on the next chat turn.
agent_prompts_can_edit: You can edit and reset prompts.
agent_prompts_readonly_note: Read-only — a superuser is required to edit.
profiles_readonly_note: Read-only — creating, editing and deleting profiles requires the superuser role.
profiles_delete_confirm: Delete profile "{name}"? This removes its KB collections and ALL its data.
llm_config_intro: Switch active models, tune generation, and configure web search. Model and web-search changes apply on the next chat turn — no restart.
llm_config_usage_periods_hint: Calendar periods in UTC: the week starts on Monday, the month on the 1st.
llm_config_backend_hint: Native uses the model's own web search (Anthropic). On a model without native search it falls back to the external provider below.
llm_config_require_allowlist: Require domain allowlist for native search
llm_config_require_allowlist_hint: When on, native search is used only if the model can restrict to the allowed domains below (Anthropic). Other models (e.g. Gemini) fall back to the external provider, which enforces the allowlist. Turn off to allow open-web native search on those models.
llm_config_allowed_domains_hint: Per agent (profile). Web results are restricted to these domains. Leaving it empty does not open the web — with no allowed domains, web search returns no results for this agent; add every domain it may cite.
llm_config_editing_disabled: Editing is disabled — set APP_SECRETS_KEY to enable. Status is read-only.
llm_config_keys_hint: Keys for the external web-search providers (Tavily / Google). Changes apply immediately — no restart.
llm_config_llm_keys_in_gateway: LLM provider credentials (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, …) are managed in the gateway console.
llm_models_intro: The models the LLM gateway offers this platform. Every model picker (agent roles, LLM templates, review process, newsletter, agent editor) offers these ids. Models, their prices and the LLM provider API keys are managed in the gateway console, not here.
llm_models_none: The gateway offers no models to this platform.
llm_models_gateway_unreachable: The gateway is unreachable, so the model list may be empty or out of date.
gateway_error_llm_unavailable: LLM figures unavailable: the gateway did not answer ({message})
collections_intro: Choose which Qdrant collection the agent answers from, and back up, restore, or wipe it.
collections_snapshots_intro: Back up, restore, import, or wipe the active knowledge base. A snapshot is taken of every KB collection — the main one and (for hierarchical PDFs) its _parents companion — so restore both together to keep them consistent. Snapshots live on the Qdrant node; download one to move it between environments.
collections_danger_intro: Permanently removes {name} and all its vectors. Type the collection name to confirm. Consider creating a snapshot first.
collections_confirm_set_active:
Make "{name}" the active collection?

This re-points the LIVE chat agent — every user's answers will now come from this collection.
collections_confirm_revert: Revert to the default collection (clear the override)?
collections_confirm_recover: Restore "{collection}" from snapshot "{name}"? Current data in that collection will be replaced.
collections_confirm_import: Import snapshot "{file}" into "{target}"? Existing data in that collection will be replaced.
collections_type_to_confirm: Type the collection name "{name}" to confirm.
collections_confirm_delete_collection: Permanently DELETE the entire collection "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
kb_intro: Every turn the improvement loop analysed. Items that produced a synthesised KB candidate need your confirmation — approving inserts the note into the curated KB tier; the rest are informational (their fix is a prompt/directive or retrieval change). Select a row to inspect it.
kb_confirm_insert: Confirm inserting this note into the curated KB tier?
rp_intro_pre: Configure, schedule, and run the continuous-improvement loop. Runs analyse recent conversations and queue knowledge candidates for
rp_intro_post: . A dedicated worker executes runs one at a time.
rp_queued: Queued — the worker will pick it up shortly.
rp_triage_all_opt: Analyse all — every collected turn (most thorough, highest cost)
rp_triage_hint: Empty, clarification, and off-topic turns are always skipped; turns with explicit feedback are always analysed. This setting controls everything in between. Pick Analyse all if runs keep finding nothing because the triage model is too strict.
rp_models_legend: Models (blank → agent defaults; pick two families for decorrelated errors)
rp_no_models: No models returned from the LLM proxy — leave blank to use the agent defaults, or check the proxy.
rp_auto_insert: Auto-insert eligible candidates (grounded · low-stakes · full agreement · high confidence). Keep off until the review approval rate is proven.
rp_curate_web: Curate content gaps from web-search turns (off by default — web data is volatile; on queues them for review)
rp_meta_retire: Meta-eval may retire net-negative curated entries
rp_findings_help_1: Analysed turns whose remediation isn't new KB content. The full list (including content gaps awaiting confirmation) lives under
rp_findings_help_2: . Prompt-fix findings are fixed by editing an
rp_no_report: No report recorded for this run.
conv_intro: Question/answer turns across all users — with the user's rating and an admin review status. Switch the event filter to browse raw audit events. Promote a good answer into the knowledge base, mark turns as reviewed, or delete a record.
conv_admin_rating_title: Rating set by an admin (overrides the user vote)
conv_no_usage: No recorded LLM usage for this turn.
conv_cost_note: Cost recorded at the rate in effect when the turn ran (not affected by later pricing changes).
conv_promote_hint: Edit the curated content before ingesting. It is chunked, embedded, and added to the KB as a curated_qa source — retrievable in future answers.
users_no_results: No users match the current filters.
users_truncated: Showing the first {limit} users. Refine the filters to narrow the list.
users_quota_title: Daily tokens used / limit in force
users_password_hint: Optional. Without a password, send the user a password-reset link afterwards.
users_superuser_hint: Superuser includes admin access and additionally allows editing the agent's phase prompts.
users_superuser_only: Only a superuser can grant or revoke this role.
users_profiles_note: Changes apply immediately. A user sees only assigned profiles in chat.
users_quota_exempt: — exempt this user from all limits
users_reset_quota_title: Reset this user's daily quota counters
ingest_intro: Manage ingested documents and URLs in the knowledge base.
ingest_none_match: No sources match the current filters.
ingest_supported: Supported: PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, MD, JSON
ingest_csv_note_1: Metadata-only import — no documents are fetched or chunked.
ingest_csv_note_2: Header must match the source schema. Required: source_id, title, source_type, legal_year, language. Optional: url, file_path, chunk_count, ingested_at, uploaded_at, status.
ingest_csv_note_3: Rows with an existing source_id are skipped. Imported rows have no vectors and are not searchable until ingested.
chat_choose_agent: Choose which agent to chat with
chat_show_last_days: Show sessions from last N days
chat_delete_confirm: Delete this chat from your history? This cannot be undone.
chat_no_chats: No chats in the last {days} days
chat_greeting: How can I help you today?
chat_welcome: Ask a question to get started.
chat_welcome_generic: Ask a question about {name} to get started.
chat_enter_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for new line
points_intro: Browse, search, add, and edit the individual vectors in the active collection.
points_dim_warning: This collection's vectors are {dim}-dim, but adding/editing points embeds at 1024-dim (bge-m3) — those writes will fail.
points_search_placeholder: Enter a natural-language query, e.g. “price of the Team plan”
points_no_results: No results found for this query.
points_import_hint: Upload an export dump (with a collection field and a points array). Each point's text is re-embedded and upserted into the active collection; _point_id becomes the point id. Large files may take a while to embed.
points_add_hint: The text is embedded with bge-m3 and stored as a single searchable vector. A hand-added point has no ingested-source row — re-ingesting or dropping the same source id later may overwrite or remove it.
points_bulk_hint: Permanently removes all vectors associated with a given reference year. This action cannot be undone.
points_load_failed: Failed to load points. Admin role required.
points_none_match: No points match the current filters.
points_text_source_required: Text and source id are required.
points_json_needs_array: JSON must have a non-empty "points" array.
points_import_note: Note: the file was exported from "{src}".
points_bulk_delete_confirm: Delete ALL vectors for reference year {year}? This cannot be undone.
point_delete_confirm: Delete this vector point? This cannot be undone.
point_load_failed: Failed to load point. It may have been deleted or you may not have permission.
point_edit_hint: Editing the text re-embeds the point (its vector is replaced). Changing only metadata leaves the vector untouched. Other payload keys (e.g. source_id, content_hash) are preserved.
landing_meta_title: PACOD — Build and run your own AI agents
landing_meta_description: A platform for specialist AI agents grounded in your own knowledge base and exact reference facts — configured in a visual editor, improved by a review loop, measured end to end.
landing_hero_eyebrow: Knowledge base · reference facts · review loop
landing_hero_title: Build and run your own AI agents.
landing_hero_sub: PACOD is a platform for specialist AI agents: each one grounded in its own knowledge base and exact reference facts, configured in a visual editor and improved from its own conversations.
landing_hero_trust: A cited source behind every answer · Available in 4 languages
landing_mock_q: What does the Team plan cost per month?
landing_mock_a: The Team plan costs EUR 49 per month and includes up to 10 users.
landing_agents_title: One platform. As many agents as you need.
landing_agents_sub: Each agent has its own knowledge base, reference facts, prompts and review history — and cites its sources.
landing_agent1_desc: The demo agent: support for a fictional software product — plans, prices, limits and service levels, answered from its knowledge base and reference facts.
landing_agent2_desc: An advanced example in a regulated domain: Bulgarian tax rules, with every rate and threshold kept as an exact reference fact.
landing_bestof_title: Everything an agent needs, in one place.
landing_bestof_feature_desc: A ready-made help-desk demo that answers from its knowledge base and reference facts. Clone it in the agent editor and make it your own.
landing_asked_q3: Answers reviewed and improved from real conversations
landing_quote_text: Every answer traces back to a document or a reference fact — and every turn can be inspected step by step in the debug console.
landing_news_title: The news that matters, in your inbox.
landing_news_sub: A periodic digest of the news our agents follow — collected and summarised by the agents, approved by people.
landing_news_success: Thanks — check your inbox to confirm.
landing_news_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
landing_cta_title: Ready to build your first agent?
landing_cta_sub: Create a free account and start with the starter agent in under a minute.
landing_footer_tagline: Build and run your own AI agents.
cookie_consent_body: {brand} uses essential cookies to run the app and remember your preferences. Analytics and advertising cookies are optional and stay off until you allow them.
cookie_consent_cat_necessary_desc: Required to sign you in and keep the app working. Always active.
cookie_consent_cat_analytics_desc: Help us see which pages get used and for how long (linked to your account when signed in). Only if you allow them.
cookie_consent_cat_marketing_desc: Let us measure our ads and show you relevant ones on Google, Microsoft (Bing), Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, Pinterest and LinkedIn.
newsletter_subtitle: Configure the per-agent news digest: crawl sources, review AI-scored topics, and send the email.
newsletter_min_relevance_hint: Articles the classifier scores below this (0–1) are dropped, keeping the digest on the agent's topic. 0 = keep everything the model includes.
newsletter_subject_hint: Tip: profile_name is replaced with the agent's name.
newsletter_model_hint: The classification model is set under LLM & Search → Newsletter model; the classifier prompt under Prompts.
newsletter_public_toggle: Public landing-page sign-ups target this agent
newsletter_public_hint: When on, the newsletter box on the public landing page subscribes visitors to this agent's newsletter (one agent platform-wide).
account_newsletter_subtitle: Subscribe to receive the email digest for your agents.
subscription_manage_billing_title: Billing is not enabled in this demo
subscription_upgrade_disabled_title: Upgrades are not available in this demo
ingest_field_body_placeholder: Paste or type the knowledge to store. Blank lines separate paragraphs; paragraphs are the chunking unit.
ingest_field_year_placeholder: Defaults to the agent's reference year
ingest_manual_note_1: Curated entries are lower authority than ingested law.
ingest_manual_note_2: Retrieval down-weights the curated tier so primary sources outrank it, and the whole tier can be switched off in settings — so an entry here informs answers, it does not override them.
curated_intro: Hand-written notes, promoted Q&A, and loop-approved candidates for this agent. They live in a separate, lower-authority tier that retrieval down-weights against primary law.
curated_filter_title: Filter by title or source id…
curated_empty: No curated entries for this agent yet.
curated_retire_hint: Remove from search but keep the record (reversible)
curated_content_load_failed: Could not load this entry's text.
curated_reconstructed_note: This entry's text was rebuilt from its stored chunks — no authored copy exists (it predates the editor, or came from the review queue). Saving replaces it with exactly what you see here.
curated_note_1: Saving replaces the entry's existing text.
curated_note_2: The old chunks are deleted before the new ones are indexed, so nothing stale survives in search.
curated_move_hint: The entry is re-indexed into the chosen agent's curated collection, then removed from this one. Unsaved edits are not carried over — save first.
curated_move_none: No other curated collection is available.
conv_review_turn_hint: Runs the full analysis pipeline on this one turn — two models, then a judge. Triage is skipped and a previous verdict is replaced.
conv_review_no_finding: The run finished without producing a finding for this turn.
conv_review_no_worker_hint: Still queued — if this doesn't start, the improvement-loop worker is probably not running.
kb_edit_note: Approval writes this text into the curated tier — correct it here first if it's wrong.
finding_directive_inactive_note: Created inactive. Directives outrank tool data at answer time — review and edit it on the Directives page before enabling it.
finding_candidate_note: Created by hand from a finding the loop did not queue.
finding_corrected_answer: What the answer should have been:
finding_evidence_degraded_hint: This verdict was reached without the retrieved sources — treat it as a guess, not a diagnosis.
finding_disposition_hint: Dismissed findings are excluded from future runs, so the same false positive stops recurring.
rp_analysis_mode_hint: Dual only means anything when models A and B are from different families — that is what makes their errors independent.
rp_panel_degraded: This will run in SINGLE mode: {reason}
rp_judge_not_independent: The judge uses an analyst's own model, so it shares that model's blind spots and can't act as an independent check.
rp_entailment_required: Verify cited passages actually support the claim
rp_entailment_hint: A similarity score only proves the passage is on the same topic — it cannot tell a claim the article supports from one it contradicts.
rp_verification_hint: Runs a real agent turn per case to check whether a fix actually held. This is the only measurement of whether a remediation worked.
rp_clusters_help: Forty turns failing on one missing source is one decision, not forty. Work these, not the individual findings.
rp_precision: Is the review itself getting better?
rp_precision_help: How often reviewers reject the loop's findings. A rate that falls after an analysis change is the evidence the change helped.
kb_already_decided: Already decided: {status}. No further action available here.
crawlers_subtitle: Which search engines, AI crawlers and preview bots fetch this site, what they receive, and whether they are who they claim to be.
crawlers_stale_warning: {bot} has not visited in over {hours}h — indexing may have stalled.
crawlers_verified_hint: Reverse and forward DNS confirm this address belongs to the operator.
crawlers_unverified_hint: The User-Agent claims this bot, but DNS does not confirm it — most likely a scraper in disguise.
crawlers_unknown_hint: This operator publishes no reverse-DNS contract, so the claim cannot be checked either way.
crawlers_none_match: No crawler visits match these filters.
crawlers_empty_window: No crawler visits in the selected period. Widen the time range to look further back.
rp_include_dismissed_hint: Re-analyse turns a reviewer dismissed. A forced re-run alone keeps them out — that is what a dismissal is for.
rp_queue_stale: A run has been marked as running for longer than the stale threshold — the worker most likely died mid-run. It is failed automatically when the worker restarts.
rp_queue_waiting: {count} request(s) have waited {minutes} min without being picked up — is the improvement-loop-worker container running?
rp_thinking_budget_hint: Extended reasoning for every review stage — the answers being judged were produced with reasoning on. 0 disables.
rp_report_load_failed: Could not load the run report.
rp_cluster_show_findings: Show the findings in this problem
rp_regression_help: Golden tests mined from confirmed answers, plus cases added by hand from findings. When fix verification is enabled, each is re-asked through the live agent and its facts are asserted.
finding_evidence_partial_hint: The reviewer saw the sources, but cut: absence from the block proves nothing.
finding_no_fix_degraded: No fix was produced: the sources the assistant read were not captured for this turn, so a correction would have been written from memory.
finding_no_fix: No fix was produced for this finding (the remediation stage returned nothing usable).
finding_golden_needs_fix: A golden test for a wrong answer needs the corrected answer and its checkable facts — none were produced for this finding.
finding_golden_hint_wrong: Stores the corrected answer and its checkable facts as the regression case.
rp_stop_hint: Stop this review. A queued request is cancelled; a running one stops at its next safe point and keeps the findings analysed so far.
rp_analysis_b_single_label: Analysis B (the critic in single mode)
rp_analysis_b_unset_single: (unset — the critic uses analysis A's own model)
rp_analysis_b_hint: Pick a model from a different family than A. Env default: {env}. Blank never falls back silently: in dual mode the run degrades to single and says so; in single mode the critic runs on A's model.
analytics_subtitle: Who uses what — requests, agent turns, LLM calls, tokens, cost and errors per domain, agent, model and user.
analytics_filter_profile_scoped_hint: Scoped by the profile selector in the top bar
analytics_hint_profile_scope: An agent filter applies only to agent and LLM metrics (turns, rejections, LLM calls, tokens, cost, errors). Page requests, API requests, page views and dwell time are tracked per domain only, so they read 0 while an agent is selected.
analytics_hint_consent: Page views and time on page are recorded only for visitors who accepted analytics cookies.
analytics_hint_lower_bound: LLM call counts from before usage analytics was introduced are a lower bound: older records grouped several calls of one turn into a single row.
analytics_users_empty: No user activity in this period.
analytics_top_pages_empty: No page views — the user may not have accepted analytics cookies.
analytics_recent_errors_empty: No LLM errors in this period.
analytics_devices_at_id: Sign-in sessions and devices are managed in pacod-id.
agent_editor_intro: Build and configure agents visually from the component library. Changes are saved as a draft, tested as a dev deployment (visible to admins only) and published to production with a version history.
agent_editor_new_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Cannot be changed later.
agent_editor_new_note: The new agent starts in development: only admins can see and test it until you publish it.
agent_editor_adopt_confirm: Hand every remaining agent to the editor? Their current configuration is published unchanged as a new version, and the settings it sets become read-only on the legacy config pages.
agent_editor_adopted: {count} agent(s) are now managed by the editor.
agent_editor_deploy_dev_title: Save and freeze this draft as the dev version — admins can test it, users are not affected.
agent_editor_publish_title: Release this draft to production (all assigned users).
agent_editor_publish_explain: The draft becomes a new immutable version that every assigned user gets on their next message. Earlier versions stay available for rollback.
agent_editor_publish_assign_all: Also give every existing user access to this agent
agent_editor_deployed_dev: Deployed to dev — try it in the Test tab.
agent_editor_unpublish_confirm: Hide this agent from users? It stays available to admins.
agent_editor_archive_confirm: Archive this agent? Nobody — admins included — can chat with it until it is released again.
agent_editor_reimport_confirm: Replace the draft with the agent's current settings? Unsaved and saved draft changes are lost (versions are kept).
agent_editor_reimported: Draft rebuilt from the current settings.
agent_editor_no_template: This agent's template is not supported.
agent_editor_palette_hint: Drag a component onto the canvas — it snaps into its place in the pipeline.
agent_editor_field_inherit_title: Drop this value and use the platform setting again
agent_editor_model_retired: This model is retired; {successor} is used instead.
agent_editor_meta_note: Names and description are applied to the agent when you publish.
agent_editor_rollback_confirm: Switch production back to this version? Users get it on their next message.
agent_editor_reset_draft_title: Replace the draft with this version
agent_editor_reset_draft_dirty: Replaces the draft — unsaved changes are lost
agent_editor_reset_draft_confirm: Discard unsaved changes and load this version?
agent_editor_draft_reset_done: Draft replaced with the selected version.
agent_editor_test_needs_dev: Deploy to dev first — the test chat talks to the dev version, never to the unsaved draft.
agent_editor_test_hint: Answers come from the dev version; users are not affected and these turns are excluded from the review process.
agent_editor_mk_intro: The landing-page card and the /agents page of this agent, per language. Published together with the agent.
agent_editor_mk_show: Show on the landing page (production only)
node_input_chat_desc: The user's message and conversation history enter here.
node_guard_language_desc: Detects the message language and restricts answers to the configured languages.
node_guard_quota_desc: Enforces the per-user token and request quotas (configured globally).
node_guard_topic_desc: LLM classifier that rejects off-topic or illegal requests and can ask for clarification.
node_cache_semantic_desc: Serves a cached answer to a sufficiently similar first-turn question.
node_memory_compaction_desc: Keeps recent turns verbatim and folds older ones into a rolling summary.
node_plan_planner_desc: Decides which tools to call and whether the question is complex.
node_tool_kb_search_desc: Two-stage semantic search over the agent's knowledge base (+ curated tier).
node_tool_web_search_desc: Allow-listed web search (Tavily / Google, or the model's native search).
node_generate_synthesizer_desc: Writes the final, cited answer from the tool context (streams tokens).
node_generate_verifier_desc: Second LLM pass that fact-checks the draft against the tool context.
node_post_suggestions_desc: Generates three follow-up questions after the answer.
node_output_chat_stream_desc: Streams tokens, citations and suggestions to the client (SSE).
chat_dev_variant_title: Admins: chat with this agent's dev deployment (agent editor) instead of the production version
agent_editor_managed_notice: This agent is managed by the Agent editor. The settings below are set by its published version — they show the values the agent runs with and can only be changed in the editor.
chat_agent_unreleased_title: Not released yet — you are chatting with its dev deployment (admins only).
agent_editor_publish_landing_warning: This agent is shown on the landing page: existing users without access will get an error when they open it from there.
agent_editor_ai_all_fields: All text fields of this component
agent_editor_ai_placeholder: Describe what this component should do, e.g. “Only answer questions about home gardening; be friendly and concise.”
agent_editor_ai_hint: Suggestions are checked and only applied when you click Apply.
agent_editor_ai_for_field: Write this with the AI assistant
agent_editor_ai_settings_intro: The language model the agent editor's assistant uses to draft prompts and content for components. One configuration for the whole editor; its usage is recorded under “agent_editor_assistant”.
agent_editor_ai_thinking_hint: 0 = off. Helps with long, rule-heavy prompts; costs more.
agent_editor_ai_guidelines_placeholder: e.g. Every prompt must forbid legal advice beyond general information. Write Bulgarian prompts in a formal register.
agent_editor_ai_guidelines_hint: Appended to the assistant's instructions for every generation.
llm_config_editor_assistant_hint: The model that drafts prompts and content in the visual agent editor. Global for the whole platform — the profile selector above does not apply to it.
llmtpl_intro: A template is a reusable set of LLM parameters: model, output budget, temperature, thinking and the rest. Every LLM role of every agent picks a template, and editing a template changes every role that uses it. Templates are global, not per agent.
llmtpl_in_use: The template is still used by these roles. Assign them another template first:
llmtpl_live_warning: Changes apply to all {count} roles using this template within a minute.
llmtpl_field_id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Leave blank to derive it from the name.
llmtpl_thinking_hint_adaptive: This model thinks adaptively. Any value above 0 turns thinking on and reserves that many extra output tokens; the depth is set by effort.
llmtpl_thinking_hint_effort: 0 = off. Any value above 0 turns reasoning on and reserves that many extra output tokens.
llmtpl_timeout_hint: Blank = the default. At most 600 s, the gateway's limit. A timed-out call is never retried.
llmtpl_roles_hint: Pick a template for each role. “Legacy” keeps that role on the individual settings further down.
llmtpl_managed_role: Owned by the published agent version, so the template is ignored
llmtpl_legacy_settings: Legacy settings (used only by roles set to Legacy)
llmtpl_stage_template_hint: With a template, the model and max-token fields below are not used for this stage.
llmtpl_assistant_template_hint: With a template, the model, temperature, max-token and thinking fields below are not used.
llmtpl_effort_hint: Applies only when thinking is on (budget above 0).
chat_welcome_starter: Ask the demo help desk about plans, prices, limits, support hours or the service levels of its fictional product.
chat_input_placeholder_starter: Ask about plans, prices, limits, support…
node_tool_reference_facts_desc: Exact lookups in the agent's reference facts — numbers, rates, amounts and dates (MCP).
reference_facts_intro: The exact numbers, rates, amounts, dates and short texts each agent quotes instead of recalling them. The agent reads them through its reference-facts tools; the selected profile scopes the list.
reference_facts_empty: No reference facts yet. Create one or import a JSON file.
reference_facts_none_match: No reference facts match the filters.
reference_facts_field_extra_hint: Optional JSON object with further typed values the agent should see, e.g. the same amount in a second currency.
reference_facts_err_year: The reference year must be four digits, or empty for every year.
reference_facts_err_extra: Extra attributes must be a JSON object.
reference_facts_import_intro: Upload a JSON array of facts (the export format). Facts are matched on key, variant and reference year within the profile “{profile}”.
reference_facts_import_replace: Replace: delete the profile's facts that are not in the file
